stage_spawn.scope: Original mode0 death continuation, Start_MakeEnemy_Stage, MakeEnemy_Stage, StageMonsterIndex, get_enemyHp, MakeEnemy_RewardBox, StageBar_Update and Character setters. Explicit input values, pool, RNG results, Unity, image/theme setup, List.Remove/AddWithResize, and coroutine dependencies.

stage_cycle.scope: Lethal hit on warm EnemyNormal -> mode0 reward box spawn -> direct EnemyBox.DeadEvent on that object -> ItemDrop -> restart factory/ctor/MoveNext -> Stage_Reset -> explicit SceneChange callback -> Stage_Restart and wave spawn. Timing and callback delivery are externally stepped. Reward effects do not credit the account.

limits: Mode 0 only. Actor activation/OnEnable, pooling, Unity transforms/scheduler and RNG internals are modeled dependencies.
RewardBox death subscriber entered directly on the newly spawned box. Box hit-to-death and multicast registration are separate.
Restart iterator and selected SceneChange callback are stepped explicitly. SceneChange scheduling and restartDelay construction are outside the tested scope.
Theme application, image loading, StageFill rendering, player initialization callbacks, and logging are modeled dependencies.
Gold/EXP drop requests and StageClear telemetry do not establish account credit or progression updates.
common_native_vm_changes: FMUL .2s by scalar lane 0, MOV .16b, unsigned UMULL, UXTW shifted ADD.
